appContext.category: AI nutrition tracking and meal analysis
appContext.summary: PrecisionCal is an AI nutrition app that turns a photo of any meal into a nutritional autopsy: it identifies every ingredient including sauces, oils and garnishes, estimates realistic portion weights, reconciles fat/carb/protein totals, and logs the meal with full transparency about how each weight was estimated. It includes a Today dashboard, meal log, analytics, a community feed called the Sanctuary, a pantry shopping list, and a Pro subscription with a 3-day free trial. Warm, calm wellness aesthetic with ivory backgrounds and terracotta and sage accents.

theme.style: Warm, calm wellness world of ivory linen, sun-warmed natural wood and soft morning daylight, with terracotta clay and muted sage tones. Gentle diffused window light, soft shadows, fine organic grain and matte ceramic textures create an unhurried, nourishing mood. Backgrounds stay airy and understated so the app UI reads clearly, never loud or clinical.

Soft golden morning daylight streams from the upper left, casting long diffused shadows and a warm glow pooling across the lower half, while the upper 30% stays calm, pale ivory and uncluttered. Shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, matte organic textures, 8K quality, ultra smooth gradients, premium feel, no text, no letters, no UI elements, no device mockups
